datasets.name: MBPP
datasets.creator: Google Research
datasets.modifications: Selected split: all. Official split IDs are recorded separately. Statement plus reference interface signatures and 1 public example assertion. The first 1 original test_list assertions are exposed in source order and excluded from evaluation; remaining test_list and all challenge_test_list assertions are held out. No result-dependent example selection. This is an explicit prompt variant, not a standard MBPP+ score.

datasets.name: SQuAD2.0 answerability
datasets.creator: Pranav Rajpurkar, Robin Jia, Percy Liang and collaborators
datasets.modifications: Original paragraphs group their original questions into q0...qN binary answerability fields. Official question IDs are preserved in the evaluation mapping. No answer span is generated. Replay records add model decisions and execution events to the original paragraph and question text.
datasets.retained_license_scope: SQuAD source text and adapted dataset records, including those embedded in replay artifacts, retain CC-BY-SA-4.0, source attribution and notice of the grouping/task modifications. Project-authored code remains separately MIT-licensed.

architectural_references.relevance: Typed probabilistic decisions, parallel output and RLCD post-training. Official speed and calibration claims do not transfer to this implementation.

architectural_references.kind: Independent black-box investigation and architectural hypothesis
architectural_references.relevance: Proposes shared-state computation, isolated question branches and direct readout. Its suggested causal/sparse backbone and readout design are not confirmed architecture.

claim_boundaries: Independent Jev-style implementation; not an official Jev reproduction or affiliation.
No official Jev training, architecture, calibration or speed claim transfers to this project.
Controller microbenchmark and whole-workload policy measurements are distinct.

redistribution.dataset_record_scope: Structured replay includes SQuAD2.0 paragraphs and questions under CC-BY-SA-4.0. Public coding replay excludes input prompts and reference solutions; it includes task IDs, generated outputs, decisions and timings. Benchmark attribution and retained notices accompany any source-derived text repeated in generated outputs. Raw datasets and third-party repositories are excluded.
